# This file was generated by running
#
# python cmake/scripts/generate-cmakefiles from dolfinx/cpp
#
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)

set(PROJECT_NAME demo_poisson_jit)
project(${PROJECT_NAME} LANGUAGES C CXX)

if(NOT TARGET dolfinx::dolfinx)
  find_package(DOLFINX REQUIRED)
endif()

if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
  include(CTest) # enables testing
endif()

# The forms are compiled when the demo runs, not when it is built, so the
# demo needs to know at run time which Python and C compiler to invoke and
# where ufcx.h lives. Ask the Python FFCx module, as FindUFCx.cmake does.
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter REQUIRED)
execute_process(
  COMMAND
    ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -c
    "import ffcx.codegeneration, sys; sys.stdout.write(ffcx.codegeneration.get_include_path())"
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE JIT_UFCX_INCLUDE_DIR
  RESULT_VARIABLE _ufcx_include_result
)
execute_process(
  COMMAND
    ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -c
    "import ffcx, sys; sys.stdout.write(ffcx.__version__)"
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE JIT_FFCX_VERSION
  RESULT_VARIABLE _ffcx_version_result
)
if(NOT _ufcx_include_result EQUAL 0 OR NOT _ffcx_version_result EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Could not query the Python FFCx module for ufcx.h.")
endif()

# Flags used to build the generated C at run time. Not the flags used to
# build this demo.
set(JIT_C_FLAGS "-O2 -shared -fPIC -std=c17")

# Boost.Process spawns FFCx and the C compiler; Boost.DLL loads the result.
# Unlike the library, this demo needs compiled Boost: Boost.Process links
# Filesystem, Atomic, Context and DateTime. BOOST_*_USE_STD_FS keep both
# libraries' own interfaces on std::filesystem.
if(POLICY CMP0167)
  cmake_policy(SET CMP0167 NEW) # Boost CONFIG mode
endif()
find_package(Boost 1.81 REQUIRED COMPONENTS process)

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE dolfinx::dolfinx Boost::process)
target_compile_definitions(
  ${PROJECT_NAME}
  PRIVATE
    BOOST_DLL_USE_STD_FS
    BOOST_PROCESS_USE_STD_FS
    JIT_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE="${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
    JIT_FFCX_VERSION="${JIT_FFCX_VERSION}"
    JIT_UFCX_INCLUDE_DIR="${JIT_UFCX_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    JIT_C_COMPILER="${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}"
    JIT_C_FLAGS="${JIT_C_FLAGS}"
)

# Set C++20 standard
target_compile_features(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Use the DOLFINx Developer compiler flags for Developer build types. Included
# by path, as putting DOLFINX_DIR on CMAKE_MODULE_PATH lets the installed
# FindUFCx.cmake shadow the ufcx CONFIG package on case-insensitive filesystems.
if(DOLFINX_DIR)
  include("${DOLFINX_DIR}/DolfinxDeveloperCompilerFlags.cmake")
else()
  include(DolfinxDeveloperCompilerFlags)
endif()
target_compile_options(
  ${PROJECT_NAME}
  PRIVATE
    $<$<AND:$<CONFIG:Developer>,$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>>:${DOLFINX_CXX_DEVELOPER_FLAGS}>
)
target_compile_definitions(
  ${PROJECT_NAME}
  PRIVATE
    $<$<AND:$<CONFIG:Developer>,$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>>:${DOLFINX_CXX_DEVELOPER_DEFINITIONS}>
)

# Do not throw error for 'multi-line comments' (these are typical in rst which
# includes LaTeX). Appended last so that it overrides -Wcomment set above.
include(CheckCXXCompilerFlag)
check_cxx_compiler_flag("-Wno-comment" HAVE_NO_MULTLINE)
target_compile_options(
  ${PROJECT_NAME}
  PRIVATE $<$<BOOL:${HAVE_NO_MULTLINE}>:-Wno-comment>
)

# Test targets (used by DOLFINx testing system)
# To select one np use, e.g.:
# ctest -R demo_poisson_jit_np_3
foreach(N 1 2 3)
  add_test(
    NAME ${PROJECT_NAME}_np_${N}
    COMMAND
      ${MPIEXEC_EXECUTABLE} ${MPIEXEC_NUMPROC_FLAG} ${N} ${MPIEXEC_PREFLAGS}
      $<TARGET_FILE:${PROJECT_NAME}> ${MPIEXEC_POSTFLAGS}
  )
  # This tells ctest how many physical cores (i.e., ${N}) are needed for each
  # test, preventing oversubscription when using e.g. `ctest -j2`.
  set_tests_properties(${PROJECT_NAME}_np_${N} PROPERTIES PROCESSORS ${N})
endforeach()
